pages_say.description: An ancient kor floating fortress risen from the ground over Akoum.
A massive ancient floating ruin covered in greenery above Sunder Bay.
The ancient floating ruin that Nahiri's party climbs and that tears itself apart when the Core is taken.
The ruin that reassembles itself after the Core is taken.
